notes.title: Hardenville’s Journey So Far
notes.content:
Hi, everyone. It’s me, the developer, checking in and responding to some comments, reviews, feedback, criticism, and support I’ve received throughout our journey so far.

Let’s take a trip back in time!

November 2021
I first discovered AVNs and was instantly hooked. I fell in love with some of the greatest games—many of the same ones you enjoy. At the same time, I played quite a few AVNs that weren’t great and thought to myself, "Wait, I could actually make something much better!"

December 2021
I downloaded Daz Studio, played around with it a bit, and saw the potential in this software.

January 2022
I started learning Ren'Py, watched tutorials, and gradually became more familiar with Python.

February 2022 – March 2023
During this period, I learned a lot about Daz, Ren'Py, and Blender. I also invested thousands of dollars into assets. Finally, I was ready to begin production on what is now known as Hardenville.

Late October 2023
Hardenville: The Prologue was released on Itch.io and Patreon, generating only a few purchases (three to five). The Steam version was supposed to launch simultaneously, but unfortunately, it remained stuck in the approval queue for three to four weeks—far longer than the usual 2-5 business days.

Early November 2023
Hardenville finally launched on Steam, and to my surprise, it was a big hit during the first weekend. It grossed almost $6,000 before Steam’s cut and taxes. I was excited about the future and believed I could already start working on this full-time.

Then, a wave of negative reviews came in: "It's too short," "Almost no content," etc. However, I had always been transparent about the average playtime on the store page.

Why Did I Release Hardenville on Steam When Only the Prologue Was Finished?
As a brand-new developer in the AVN industry—where new games release daily—it’s incredibly difficult to get recognized and build a player base. Releasing in Early Access on Steam helps gain visibility much faster. However, the trade-off is lower income on Patreon and other subscription-based platforms that many AVN developers rely on.

Hardenville is and will remain a single-purchase game. You get all episodes for one price—no extra fees, no paid DLC for more lewd scenes.

Unfortunately, after the big opening weekend, sales dropped drastically. In fact, from the Monday after release until today (March 2025), the game has earned less in total than it did during that first weekend alone. This financial reality has been a major factor behind the delays and unfulfilled promises.

Why Has Development Been Slower Than Expected?
At first, I thought I could work on this project full-time. But I quickly realized that wasn’t feasible yet. My hope is that after a few more episodes and more positive feedback, I’ll be able to make this my full-time job. If that happens, development will speed up significantly because I’ll be able to dedicate more time to it.

I’m a solo developer, and yes, I have missed deadlines—a lot. I sincerely apologize for that. That’s on me, and I truly wish things had gone differently. However, my goal remains the same: to deliver fantastic episodes that leave you feeling satisfied and make your hard-earned money spent on this game worth it.

It’s better to take the time to create something great—something I’m proud of—rather than rushing the process and leaving you uninterested in playing future episodes. Hopefully, once Hardenville is completed and I begin a new project, you’ll be able to look back and say:

"I really liked Hardenville, and I have high hopes for his upcoming game. The only issue was the delays—if the dev has mostly sorted that out, we’re in for a great experience!"

Addressing Concerns About the English Version
I’ve seen comments across the web mentioning that the English version had poor grammar. As of a recent update, the game has been fully proofread by a professional English proofreader.

Addressing Concerns About the Future of Hardenville
I know many people believe this project will end up abandoned like many other AVNs. Some even think I’m scamming them. Personally, this is really tough to hear. All I want to do is create a fantastic game that we can all enjoy, given the time I have available.

I will finish and deliver up to Episode 9, as promised. However, as with many Early Access games, development takes time, and delays happen.

When Is Episode 2 Coming?
I’ve been careful about sharing release dates, especially after the backlash over previous delays. However, I recently announced that Episode 2 is coming in May. Unfortunately, even when I provide a release window, I still receive negative feedback.

Final Thoughts
Please remember—I’m just one guy, working on my first release, doing something I love. I truly hope I can do this full-time in the future. More content will lead to better reviews, which will lead to more income, which will eventually allow me to make this my career.

To be clear, I haven’t taken a single penny from Hardenville as salary yet. Every dollar earned has been reinvested into the project.

I want you to know that I hear you, I care about your feedback, and I truly appreciate your patience, support, and for purchasing Hardenville.

Let’s make this a fantastic game together!

notes.title: Hardenville Episode 2 | Early 2025

However, I encourage you to stay optimistic and trust that the extra time is being used to immerse you deeply in the story with high-quality renders, captivating writing, and atmospheric sound design. If I didn’t care deeply about making Hardenville the best it can be, I could have opted to release a shorter, unfinished, or "cheap" version of Episode 2—but nobody wants that. On a positive note, I’m happy to announce that a small update for Episode 1 (Version 0.2.4) will be releasing soon. The entire script has been professionally proofread by an English expert, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable reading experience. notes.title: Dev Log #13 | Episode 2
notes.content:
Dev Log #13 | Episode 2
Published on Patreon, SubscribeStar, Itch.io, Discord, and Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42446131/8488756aa308372e9ff9b773feebfae3262c3911.png

Introduction and Progress Update
Thank you for supporting my project, Hardenville. This past year has been a challenging journey, with more personal ups and downs than I anticipated. However, I’m thrilled by how much I’ve grown in coding and rendering since The Prologue. Several key improvements have been made for Episode 2, including:

 Improved Field of View and Camera Positioning: Adjustments for a more immersive first-person experience.
 Improved Lighting: Optimized lighting setups for more realistic and visually appealing scenes.
 Better Character Rigging: Significant improvements to character bones and rigging, making it easier to create natural poses and expressions.
 Rendering Optimizations: These changes lead to faster rendering times, allowing for quicker updates and progress.


These improvements are all aimed at making Hardenville a more polished and enjoyable experience.

Episode 2: A Shift in Focus
Based on the feedback I received from Episode 1, I’ve made significant improvements to the script and overall flow for Episode 2. This episode will continue the detailed style you enjoyed in Episode 1 but with a new focus on romance and professionalism. The cringe humor from The Prologue has been greatly reduced, allowing for a more mature and engaging narrative. Inspired by titles like Summer Heat by Naughty Fox Games and Summer's Gone by Ocean, I’m committed to creating something uniquely Hardenville—a game that stands out for its style and emotional depth.

This new direction will make Hardenville more appealing to a broader audience while maintaining the essence of what makes it special.

The Importance of Episode 2
Delivering a perfect Episode 2 is crucial for the future of Hardenville. The success of this episode will directly impact my ability to attract more players, improve reviews, and generate the income needed to continue development at the pace this project deserves. If Episode 2 is well-received, I can dedicate more time to Hardenville, resulting in shorter development cycles between updates. Conversely, a lukewarm reception might force me to split my time with other jobs to maintain a steady income.

Rest assured, I will never abandon Hardenville, no matter what. However, the reception of Episode 2 will significantly influence how quickly and frequently I can deliver new content.

Financial Situation and Time Constraints
Currently, I’m in a tight financial situation, with credit cards maxed out because every cent has gone into this project. I can continue working on Hardenville as planned until November or December. My goal is to see Hardenville move from a Mixed to a Positive rating on Steam by the end of the year, thanks to the improvements and new content in Episode 2, including deeper romance and enhanced erotic elements.

Feedback and Release Schedule Adjustments
I’ve heard your feedback, especially from Patreon and SubscribeStar members who feel they aren't getting enough value. As a result, I’ll be focusing more on these platforms moving forward, sharing more frequent Dev Logs, polls, and development updates. Currently, these two platforms are my primary sources of revenue, with Patreon leading at $148 a month before taxes. My hope is that this increased focus will attract more members and provide the necessary support to sustain Hardenville’s development.

To manage expectations better, I need to set the release date for Episode 2 to simply "2024" and leave the release dates for Episodes 3 through 9 as TBA until I have a better handle on the time required for each episode.

Development Timeline and Rendering Goals
If everything goes according to plan, I’ll begin rendering later this week—at the latest, early next week. Episode 2 will feature nearly 1,000 renders and a few erotic animations for the sex scenes. Once the rendering phase begins, I expect to produce between 50 and 120 static renders each week, depending on other tasks such as coding and script development.

Member Benefits and Platform-Specific Updates
Member Benefits:

 Gold Members and Above: Receive major game updates, including the first releases of each episode in an Alpha state, one week before the stable release.
 Silver Members and Above: Receive major game updates in a Beta state three days before the stable release.
 Bronze Members, Steam, and Itch.io Owners: Receive the stable release one week after the Alpha, ensuring the highest quality upon release on platforms like Steam and Itch.io.


All minor updates within episodes will be released simultaneously across all platforms, meaning only the initial episode releases will have Alpha and Beta stages.

To my Steam and Itch.io buyers, I want you to know that you’re not being left out. You will still receive updates, release notes, and major news like release dates. However, due to the different requirements for banners, image sizes, and file formats on these platforms, I’m focusing my detailed updates on Patreon and SubscribeStar. This approach allows me to dedicate more time to development while keeping you informed.

Many Thanks
Thank you again for your continued support! I am committed to making Hardenville the best it can be, and with your help, we can achieve great things. I’m excited to deliver an Episode 2 that exceeds your expectations and helps Hardenville reach new heights.

 Italian

Q: Who can apply as a translator for Hardenville?
A: Everyone!

Q: What experience do I need?
A: Mastery of the target language and a strong understanding of English.

Q: How can I apply?
A: Share a bit about yourself, the language you'd like to translate, and send us an email at contact@joyfigames.com

Q: How many will be selected?
A: We aim to have at least two individuals for each language.

Q: When will I know if I've been selected as a translator?
A: While we're prioritizing this process, it may take a few weeks. You'll receive a confirmation email promptly upon receiving your application.

Q: What happens if I get selected?
A: Once selected, you'll gain access to an exclusive Discord channel for all translators and another exclusive channel specifically for translators of the chosen language.

Q: What do I get in return?
A: Exclusive insights into Hardenville's development, early access to builds, and the highest tier on Discord, offering exclusive renders. In the coming months, we plan to extend additional perks such as Steam gift cards. It's important to note that, initially, translation of Hardenville is a community project, and the benefits are not comparable to a permanent translator position.

New Equipment
After some time, we've received the majority of our PC parts for our second build, featuring a 14th gen i9, 128GB DDR5 RAM, 4TB of NVMe storage, and more. Unfortunately, the RTX 4090 I desire is still out of stock, leading me to temporarily borrow the RTX 3090 from my old rig. However, we may be getting ahead of ourselves. I'll provide an update in a few weeks or months regarding VR support.

Check out https://www.joyfigames.com/


Progress on Episode 1

However, I'm pleased with the current look, and with the website and new rig set up, progress will be faster moving forward.

notes.title: Hardenville: News and Q&A #1
notes.content:
News
It's been just over two weeks since we launched Hardenville The Prologue version here on Steam. We're thrilled to be on this journey with you and are dedicated to delivering the best experiences with our upcoming releases. Thank you all for your positive and constructive feedback.

Our goal is to maintain transparency and cultivate a vibrant community, even though it may take some time to grow. We're proud to share that our Discord community has reached 286 members. Additionally, Hardenville is nearing 2,000 units sold on Steam in just two weeks, which is a remarkable achievement for The Prologue. Once the revenue hits our bank account in late December, we'll invest in an additional PC equipped with an RTX 4090. This new PC will aid in static renders, allowing us to multitask alongside our current PC with a RTX 3090 solely for animations. This marks a significant milestone for us!

Our next release, Episode 1, is scheduled for late December or January. It will offer at least twice the content of The Prologue, including a substantial amount of animations.

Unfortunately, as of today, Hardenville holds a "mixed" rating on Steam due to the overall negative reviews mainly concerning the current length of the game. We understand this perspective and view it as a constructive criticism moving forward. We're hopeful that with the release of Episode 1, we can elevate our rating from "mixed" to "positive".

We're aware that some developers have abandoned their Adult Visual Novels over time, and this concern may linger among supporters. Our aim was to garner early support to assure everyone that this game won't be abandoned. Thanks to the Early Access on Steam, we've received substantial backing, reassuring us of our community's support. Please rest assured that Hardenville is intended to encompass a total of 10 chapters, with The Prologue serving as Chapter 1 and Episodes 1 through 9 constituting the remaining chapters. We've meticulously planned the entire season and even have exciting ideas for a potential Season 2.

We also promise that all upcoming episodes of Hardenville Season 1 will be accessible at no extra cost to those who purchase it. Furthermore, there won't be any other DLCs, such as additional purchases for more explicit content in the game. It's one purchase and one purchase only!

We aim to introduce voice actresses into Hardenville at a later stage, likely towards the end of the Early Access period.

Q&A #1
Now, let's delve into the Q&A session. Which languages would you like to see available in Hardenville? Please share your thoughts, questions, concerns, feedback, and more in the comment section below. Your input is highly valuable to us.

A question and concern that have been seen in some places is:
Q: "That a main LI willing to give a random dude a head in a porta potty doesn't really inspire me with much confidence in this."
A: Sandra, one of the main LIs, has a compelling reason that will be revealed at the Home-Alone party in Episode 1. Just hang tight. Natalie is more like a side LI.

notes.title: What's next for Hardenville
notes.content:
Thank you!
We'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your support and interest in our passion project, Hardenville.

We've always planned for the Prologue to be a short introduction to introduce players to the characters in Hardenville. A total of 10 chapters are planned, with the Prologue being the first and Episode 1 to 9 making up the remaining chapters. The Episodes will contain much more content and animations compared to the Prologue.

While we have noticed in reviews that some people find the Prologue too short, it was a deliberate decision to bring the game to Early Access on Steam with the first chapter. Typically, other visual novels don't do this until about mid-development cycle. We believed it was best to release the game early, gather feedback, and gain support to improve the game significantly. Our plans include translating the game into multiple languages, adding voice actresses at some point, expanding our team and much more.

At present, Hardenville is a solo endeavor led by Filip, a 25-year-old Norwegian developer.

The planned release schedule for Hardenville episodes is as follows:
